verdict.rationale: Elastic's own marketing and docs claim AI insights inside the product: natural-language interaction with telemetry, an AI SRE (nightshift) that investigates incidents and delivers evidence-backed root cause, AI-driven log parsing and analysis in Streams, and surfacing of correlations and root causes. These are short vendor claims with no hands-on or independent corroboration, and explicit actionable suggestions or remediation recommendations are not evidenced. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the AI assistant and insight workflows, evidence of AI-generated remediation suggestions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Interact directly with your telemetry through natural language and resolve problems faster without switching tabs or context.
Elastic nightshift AI SRE detects and investigates incidents, delivering evidence-backed root cause.
Streams leverages AI to automatically parse, structure, and analyze log data on the fly.
This includes zero-config anomaly detection, pattern analysis, and the ability to surface correlations and root causes.
